title: Video follow-up, left shoulder, bra and top shelf

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Dolores, I can see you. Tell me about the shoulder.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The left shoulder is 2 out of 10 at its worst this week. Much better than last month.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I can get my bra on by myself now.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Good. Are you doing the exercises?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The pulley exercises every morning. The wall walks, not so much.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Any tingling in your hand, or neck pain?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No tingling. My neck is fine.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Let's look at your arm lifting. On the screen it seems to reach about shoulder height, but I can't measure degrees over video.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I can reach the top shelf with a stool.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: keep pulleys every morning, bring the wall walks back three days a week, and test your strength in person at the next visit.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay. My goal is to go on a cruise in March without thinking about my shoulder all day.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Let's make that goal work. The in-person visit is next Tuesday.

expectedFacts.statement: Left shoulder 2 out of 10 at worst this week
Can reach top shelf with a stool
Wall walks three days a week
Strength test in person at next visit
Goal: go on a cruise in March
